items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I don't understand Snowden and Howard Scott talking about they couldn't understand that.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, those are words, sophistication and whatever. But I always appreciated those people from the south, because they had a culture, and when they said, "My baby left me. My baby left me a mule to ride," or whatever, that was their culture. They were singing their hearts out, telling you, "Please understand me. I'm trying to make you understand." And I don't understand Snowden and Howard Scott talking about they couldn't understand that. That's a lot of crap! Believe me. I don't believe it!
